QUOTE: "**No exceptions cross the boundary.** Python callbacks catch all exceptions, print a traceback, and return a neutral value. In the hook trampoline, a raised exception becomes "pass through" (`rc = 0`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the hook trampoline catches all exceptions so none unwind into the C engine, and that a failed hook is treated as pass-through (rc = 0).
